value.title: Belgium, Luxembourg, Netherlands, and THAT Dog
value.synopsis: Belgium and Luxembourg tend to be at the mercy of others, so they pledge to become strong. Meanwhile, Belgium is curious about a certain dog that tourists often ask about.

value.title: Let's Celebrate Christmas!
value.synopsis: Merry Christmas! Italy, Germany, and Japan take a look at how others spend Christmas. Italy visits Germany on December 31st.

value.title: Let's Celebrate the New Year
value.synopsis: Let's check on how everyone is spending New Year's. Japan also learns how to make Stollen from Germany before Christmas.
